title: Tôi có thể chụp ảnh ở đây được không?
englishTitle: Can I take a photo here?
pronunciation: Toi co the chup anh o day duoc khong
summary: For checking photo rules before raising your camera at a temple, museum, shop, or viewpoint.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask before taking the shot when signs are unclear or staff are nearby.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Gesture lightly toward your phone or camera, say the phrase, then wait for yes, no, or a pointed boundary.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể chụp ảnh ở đây được không?
phrases.english: Can I take a photo here?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the chup anh o day duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi có thể asks can I; chụp ảnh means take a photo; ở đây được không asks if it is allowed here.

breakdown.vietnamese: Tôi có thể chụp ảnh ở đây được không?
breakdown.english: Can I take a photo here?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Photography allowed, what to avoid, and included in ticket phrases cover nearby permission checks.

phrases.vietnamese: Có được phép chụp ảnh không?
phrases.pronunciation: Co duoc phep chup anh khong

phrases.vietnamese: Cái này có bao gồm trong vé không?
phrases.english: Is this included in the ticket?
phrases.pronunciation: Cai nay co bao gom trong ve khong

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at temples, museums, ticketed attractions, workshops, markets, and places where people may not want photos.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: A small nod or crossed-arm gesture may be the answer. Respect that first before asking for detail.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Entrance, exit, less crowded, safe at night, and written name phrases help when the visit continues.
